settings.text: Every class on this page is the same global class the Service, Program, About, Contact and Branch templates use. Editing one here changes it everywhere.
Section title, lead, body and eyebrow. One H1 per page — the H1 style is applied inline in templates, not as a class, because it is used once.

Buttons are ACSS classes attached via _cssClasses — Bricks does not define them. btn--accent is the quote CTA (orange), btn--primary is the call CTA (green).

Trust strip, spec items, steps and tick lists. None of these titles are headings — they are labels.
Every technician is trained and certified.
Treatments matched to grass type and season.
You know what was applied and why.
We inspect the lawn and identify what is limiting it.
The right application for the grass and the season.
We check the response and adjust the next round.
Questions are H3. The accordion element supplies the interaction; these classes supply the type.
How soon will I see a difference?
Most lawns show visible response within two to three weeks, depending on the season and the condition of the turf when we started.
Do I need to be home for treatment?
No. We treat the lawn and leave a summary of what was applied.
Tell us about your lawn and we will recommend the right programme.
